current_checkpoint.name: Line 6 Helix Stadium Poly Sustain-inspired hold

official_source.title: Helix Stadium model catalogue, current manual, and older Helix release notes
official_source.revision: Stadium online manual Rev E / v1.4.1 as shown on 2026-11-23; hardware release notes v1.4.2; Helix 3.0/3.10 notes are role references only
official_source.qualification: The catalogue marks Stadium Poly Sustain mono, polyphonic, DSP-intensive, and introduced in Stadium 1.0. Older Helix notes describe control roles but do not establish Stadium numeric ranges/defaults or exact current controls. Stadium DSP guidance allows at most two Poly effects per preset and one per primary path.

current_checkpoint.documented_controls: Older Helix notes list Interval, Attack, Decay, Mod Freq/Depth, FX Level, RandDpth, RandSpeed, and Level; v3.10 adds Auto EQ and Normal/Dry Kill/Mute All operation. These are not a Stadium parameter table. Stadium-specific bounds/defaults remain unknown.
current_checkpoint.project_controls: Project-authored 80 ms time-domain hold reuses PitchSequence capture and the polyphonic shifter. Controls: interval -12..+12 semitones, Attack 0..2,000 ms, Decay after bypass 0..10,000 ms, FX Level 0..1, project Level -24..+12 dB, and Normal/Dry Kill/Mute All. Modulation/random controls, Auto EQ, Line 6 spectral processing, settings/DSP/sound parity are not implemented or claimed.

verification.browser_native_comparison: 71 active stages passed at 48 kHz stereo; max absolute error 0.0000067345867762469425, RMS error 0.0000012094738996969572
verification.poly_sustain_playback: make web-browser-test passed the categorized Delay picker and captured changed output from the project-authored Poly Sustain using existing local prerecorded guitar audio
verification.notes: Project-only Poly Sustain is excluded from native parity because the offline renderer has no matching option. Human listening, physical device checks, and Line 6 DSP/settings/sound parity remain open.
